Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. The catalog provider is the online-catalog and catalog-tree layer: the aggregate collection subscribes to its source collections and raises one weak collection-changed event, the tree items raise property-changed events and index their trees per CatalogItemSource, and the online classes use the download proxy over OnlineCatalogSettings.BaseUrl.
Method.resource/format strings: OnlineCatalogFileProvider.EnsureDirectories creates IndexFiles and MarketFile.mf; GetIndexFileName formats '{0}.idx'; OnlineCatalogSettings.GetBaseUrl reads the OnlineCatalogUrl app setting with the default http://onlinecatalog.knx.org.
